unverified_issue_candidates.quote: Evaluating variables $v_{i}$ one by one together with their corresponding $\dot{v}{i}$ values gives us the required derivative in the final variable $\dot{v}{5}=\frac{\partial y}{\partial x_{1}}.$
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: OCR 中 $\dot{v}{i}$ 和 $\dot{v}{5}$ 的下标花括号丢失，应为 $\dot{v}_{i}$ 和 $\dot{v}_{5}$，影响公式可读性但不影响理解。

unverified_issue_candidates.quote: In simple terms, we are interested in computing the contribution $\bar{v}{i}=\frac{\partial y}{\partial v{i}}$ of the change in each variable $v_{i}$ to the change in the output y.
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: OCR 中 $\bar{v}{i}$ 和 $\partial v{i}$ 的下标花括号丢失，应为 $\bar{v}_{i}$ 和 $\partial v_{i}$，影响公式可读性但不影响理解。

unverified_issue_candidates.quote: After the forward sweep on the left hand side, we run the reverse sweep of the adjoints on the right hand side, starting with $\bar{v}{5}=\bar{y}=\frac{\partial y}{\partial y}=1$ . In the end we get the derivatives $\frac{\partial y}{\partial x{1}}=\bar{x}{1}$ and $\frac{\partial y}{\partial x{2}}=\bar{x}_{2}$ in just one reverse sweep.
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: OCR 中 $\bar{v}{5}$、$\partial x{1}$、$\bar{x}{1}$、$\partial x{2}$ 的下标花括号丢失，应为 $\bar{v}_{5}$、$\partial x_{1}$、$\bar{x}_{1}$、$\partial x_{2}$，影响公式可读性但不影响理解。
